messages:
sam: Promo held — CI canary failed for release v2.3.1. deploy-bot reports artifact checksum mismatch + cache fetch errors. anyone on call?

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: canary job `canary-frontend-42` failed.
Logs:
```
fetch artifact s3://redwood-artifacts/frontend/v2.3.1.tar.gz -> 404
reuploading artifact... uploaded as multipart part-trace-873
computed sha256: abc123... but registry metadata expected sha256: def456...
exit status 1
```
jen: I'm on it — seeing repeated 404s from the staging registry when the CI runner tries to pull the tarball. then a reupload produced a different digest. possible multipart reupload race or TTL/consistency window. :thinking_face:
aditya: sounds like the ephemeral upload TTL + parallel reuploads race we saw before. if two runners reupload the same filename rapidly, S3 multipart can produce different object etags and we end up with digest drift. TTL for the deploy cache is 8s currently.
marie: For the release window: do we pin to last-good digest and promote, or hold until we fix the registry? what's the risk?
sam: pinning last-good digest would unblock the promo immediately. risk is if the code actually changed (unlikely here). rollback surface area small — it's only the frontend static bundle.
aditya: recommended mitigation: promote pinned digest sha256:0f1e2d3c (last-promoted). then open a registry dedupe ticket and increase cache TTL to 30s for the next deploy wave. command to run:
```
# pin and force promote to prod
deploybot promote --image frontend:v2.3.1 --image-digest sha256:0f1e2d3c --force --reason "pin to last-good due to registry multipart reupload"
```
jen: running tests against pinned digest locally — quick smoke looks fine. E2E flake unrelated: `test_search_index_indexing_timeout` failed twice on staging, but that's a separate flaky test. I'm okay to promote pinned image as long as we throttle canary.
sam: ok let's throttle: canary size 1 -> 3, wait 5m, health checks, then promote. jen can you run promote and monitor? I'll update release notes and alert #release-watch.
jen: running promote now. deploy-bot: triggering promote job... :rocket:
deploy-bot: promote job started: job-8543.
ops-bot: Note — creating incident ticket INF-348 for registry dedupe and cache TTL increase.
jen: promote job logs:
```
[00:01] pulled digest sha256:0f1e2d3c
[00:02] deploy canary replicas=1 -> healthcheck passed
[00:07] scale canary replicas=3 -> healthchecks 3/3
[00:12] canary metrics within SLO
[00:15] promote to prod started
[00:20] promotion completed, new prod tag points to sha256:0f1e2d3c
```
sam: Nice. :tada: canary healthy and promoted. I'll leave the hold note on the release and mark as unblocked in the release tracker.
aditya: reopening followup: please set cache TTL to 30s in config `deploy-cache.ttl` and add a short e2e job that verifies artifact digest after push to registry. filing PR now.
marie: thanks everyone. logging postmortem checklist: root cause hypothesis (multipart reupload race), mitigation (pin + TTL bump), long-term (registry dedupe / stronger artifact verification), owner @aditya.
jen: will keep an eye on the search-index flakes and follow up in #eng-sre. closing thread for v2.3.1 promo — no rollback needed. :white_check_mark:
